g.text: Toy model of an Earth-observation smallsat standing in for an expensive simulation: four variables (altitude 400–800 km, aperture 0.15–0.6 m, array 1–6 m², propellant 0–60
kg); value = lifetime × images per day × value per image / cost. Gaussian process with a Matérn kernel (scikit-learn), expected-improvement (EI) acquisition, 6 Latin-hypercube
starts, 40 evaluations; crosses = runs that did not reach 95 %. In (a) the other three variables are held at their optimum values.
